metadataAutofill.loading: Loading Spotify details and checking the artist and year in MusicBrainz…
metadataAutofill.linked: Filled in MusicBrainz details linked to this Spotify URL. Check the artist and year before saving.
metadataAutofill.linkedNoYear: Found the artist for this Spotify URL, but no verified year. Enter the year or search for the correct release.
metadataAutofill.chooseMatch: Choose the correct recording to fill in the artist and year. If it is missing, enter the artist and search again. A title alone does not verify the version at the Spotify link.
metadataAutofill.selected: Filled in details from the selected MusicBrainz recording. Check that it matches the version at the Spotify link before saving.
metadataAutofill.selectedNoYear: Filled in the title and artist from the selected MusicBrainz recording. No release date is available — enter the year manually.
metadataAutofill.noMatch: Could not verify the remaining details. Enter them manually or search again — a title is enough.
metadataAutofill.findDetails: Find artist and year in MusicBrainz
metadataAutofill.titleSearch: Search by title. Adding the artist narrows the results and helps find the correct year.
